text: Beyond the old highway lies wilderness no one has crossed. Pack enough food and water, and the team will map these outskirts one tile at a time.
{变量1} residents shouldered their packs and set out. While they are away, the settlement has fewer hands at work and fewer mouths to feed.
The team has returned to the settlement. Their supplies have been counted and stored.
The team's water or food bags are nearly empty. If they push on, someone may collapse along the way.
The team has run out of supplies in the wilderness. They can only stop where they are and light a distress signal.
Gray-shelled beetles shove rubble around in the hollow. Their backs gleam like old car paint. At the sound of voices, they all raise their forelegs.
The wind-speed readings match the settlement's daily observations. Before the next cold wind arrives, the people on duty will reinforce the grain shed's shutters.
The world is paused. Resume time before setting out.
In the city phase, patrols watch over the outskirts.
